title: Onboarding snapshot storyboards & sales collateral for quickstart flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a set of six sales-facing visual assets derived from current product screenshots that tell a concise onboarding story (snapshot storyboards). These assets will be used in the Sales Quickstart deck and in one-pagers for Solution Engineering. The goal is to showcase the fastest path from sign-up -> first successful inference -> cost/latency dashboard insights. Assets must be annotated, annotated-callout friendly, and export-ready for web and PDF. Include localized copy placeholders for EN/FR/DE.
acceptance_criteria: Six storyboard slides assembled: Hero, Sign-up & API key, First request (chat/text gen), Embeddings sample, Performance & cost dashboard, Rollout/next steps
Each slide has a desktop and mobile screenshot variant with consistent device frames
All callouts use the approved RedWood palette and token styles, with contrast ratios meeting AA
Exported PNG and vector PDF for each slide; GIFs for two micro-interactions (input->streaming, dashboard filter) sized under 5MB
Stakeholder approvals recorded from PM (Liam Chen) and Sales Lead (Maya Singh)
Accessible alt text provided for each exported asset
tasks: Audit latest product screenshots (console-2026.03) and capture fresh frames at 1440x900 and 390x844
Design 6 storyboard layouts in Figma, using 'Snapshot Story' component library
Create annotated callouts and speaker notes for sales use
Produce 2 lightweight micro-interaction GIFs demonstrating streaming and dashboard filter behavior
Localize copy placeholders for EN/FR/DE and add notes for translation team
Export assets, compress GIFs, and upload to shared Drive folder
image_specs: Desktop screenshots: 1440x900 at 2x export; crop to 1280x720 frame for deck
Mobile screenshots: 390x844 at 3x export; center safe area at 375x812
Device frames: use RedWood device-frame component, drop shadow elevation 08
Callouts: rounded rectangle 8px radius, stroke 1px, primary accent #0066FF, label font Inter 600 14px
Contrast: foreground callout text >= AA against overlay; overlay opacity 28% dark
Annotations: use number badges (circle 20px, white text) and short 6-12 word captions
motion_specs: Streaming GIF: 800x450, 24fps, loop once then hold final frame; highlight token streaming with animated blue pulse
Dashboard GIF: 720x400, show filter click -> latency/cost chart update; 12fps to keep size low
Duration: keep under 4s for streaming, under 3s for dashboard
Export settings: GIF optimized with lossy 20% and transparent background when possible
export_instructions: PNG exports: sRGB, 72dpi, no metadata, 8-bit PNG-24
PDF: export vector text where possible; rasterize shadows at 300dpi
GIFs: use Gifsicle or Ezgif with lossy=20, color-reduction to 128 colors
Upload all final assets to Drive folder and attach to this ticket
links: GitHub PR for screenshot capture tooling: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/487
